function.name: team_api_TeamApi_delete_team
function.description: Deletes the specified team from the system. The operation cannot be undone once completed. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

team_id.description: The unique identifier of the team to be deleted.

confirm.description: A flag that must be set to true to confirm the deletion of the team. This acts as a safeguard against accidental deletions.

function.name: user_api_UserApi_delete_ldap_user
function.description: Deletes an LDAP user from the system by their unique user ID. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

user_id.description: The unique identifier of the LDAP user to be deleted.

confirm.description: A flag to confirm the deletion of the user. Must be set to true to proceed with deletion.

function.name: user_api_delete_managed_user
function.description: This function permanently removes a user from the system. It requires the user's unique identifier to execute. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

user_id.description: The unique identifier of the user to be deleted.

confirmation.description: A flag to confirm the deletion operation. Must be set to true to proceed.

function.name: user_api_UserApi_remove_team_from_user
function.description: This function removes a specified user from a team, effectively revoking their team-related privileges. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

username.description: The unique identifier of the user to be removed from the team.

team_id.description: The unique identifier of the team from which the user will be removed.

function.name: permission_api_PermissionApi_remove_permission_from_user
function.description: Removes a specified permission from a user account. This action ensures that the user will no longer have the rights associated with the removed permission. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

username.description: The unique identifier of the user account from which the permission will be removed. The username should be in the format of a valid email address, such as 'user@example.com'.

permission.description: The specific permission to be removed from the user account. For example, it can be 'read', 'write', 'delete', etc.
